scope: Complete official Zendesk Support OAS 2.0.0 operation ledger: 625 official operations inventoried exactly once. Existing fixture-backed streams and reverse-ETL writes remain covered; non-executable official operations are blocked by default as typed operation metadata. Supplemental covered_by rows are included only for existing Airbyte/Zendesk Guide/community bundle surfaces not present in the Support OAS so connector validation remains truthful.
